close_reason: Added comment to reg! macro explaining that _ci (ignore) is used for most handlers, and ci (capture) is only needed for handlers that emit onSuccess* extra invocations.
description: lib.rs lines 85-97: the reg\! macro exposes a ci/call_id parameter. Most handlers use _ci (ignoring it), but Email/copy and EmailSubmission/set use ci. The invariant — 'only handlers that emit onSuccess* extra invocations need call_id' — is nowhere documented. A contributor adding a new handler must guess whether to use ci or _ci. Add a comment to the macro or its usage sites explaining which handlers need call_id and why.
title: reg\! macro ci vs _ci invariant undocumented
